description: Restyle the form-heavy dashboard features and the calendar subsystem to shadcn/ui: services, team, hours, profile, the owner reviews controls, and the full calendar (grid, form-sheet, booking-details, manual-booking-form, block-form). Presentation only — preserve every server action, the shared zod validation + blur/submit error display, the idempotency nonce, STATUS_STYLE icon+border semantics, native date/time/color inputs, accessibility wiring, and i18n keys. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs components/ui/* and the dark variant). Should run after FEAT-002 since both edit the one shared worktree.
steps: Services: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/services/page.tsx, components/services/services-manager.tsx, components/services/service-form.tsx. List rows -> shadcn Card + Separator; action buttons -> shadcn Button keeping icon-only aria-labels (edit/hide/show/move up/move down/delete); visibility pill -> shadcn Badge; the add/edit form -> shadcn Input/Label/Select/Button/Textarea. Keep controlled fields, the shared serviceInputSchema validation + shown-after-blur/submit logic, translations (el/ru) details block, and createService/updateService/deleteService/moveService/setServiceActive actions, plus FormSheet/ConfirmSheet wiring. i18n keys (services, categories) unchanged.

Team: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/team/page.tsx, components/team/team-manager.tsx, components/team/staff-form.tsx. KEEP native <input type="time" step=900> for per-day hours and native <input type="date" min=...> for days off — style via shadcn Input className only, preserving step/min/required/disabled/aria-invalid/aria-describedby and the data-field focus targeting. Keep save/day-off actions, shared team-schema validation, and FormSheet/ConfirmSheet wiring. i18n (team, business weekday keys) unchanged.

Hours: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/hours/page.tsx, components/hours/hours-editor.tsx, components/hours/closures-manager.tsx. KEEP native <input type="time"> (relies on step=stepSeconds, required, disabled, the 23:59 cap, data-field targeting) and native <input type="date" min=...> in closures. Style via shadcn Input/Button/Card/Separator className only. Keep saveBusinessHours + closure actions, checkBusinessHours validation, copy-to-all-days, the timezone note, and aria-live status region. i18n (hours) unchanged.

Profile: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/profile/page.tsx, components/profile/profile-form.tsx, components/profile/brand-form.tsx, components/profile/photos-manager.tsx. shadcn Card/Input/Label/Textarea/Button. KEEP native <input type="color"> in brand-form and its live brand preview + lib/brand contrast-validation call sites unchanged. Keep profile/brand/photo server actions, Cloudinary upload flow, the el/ru translation fields, and the profile i18n keys. photos-manager uses the shared ConfirmSheet — do not change that shared component.

Reviews controls: restyle components/reviews/owner-reply-form.tsx and components/reviews/report-review-button.tsx with shadcn Button/Input/Textarea. Do NOT touch components/reviews/review-form.tsx (public customer form). Keep the reply/report actions and i18n keys.

Calendar: restyle app/[locale]/dashboard/calendar/page.tsx (prev/today/next nav links, the day/week segmented control -> shadcn Tabs or Button group, staff chips -> shadcn Badge/Button, show/hide cancelled link) and components/calendar/calendar-grid.tsx, components/calendar/form-sheet.tsx, components/calendar/booking-details.tsx, components/calendar/manual-booking-form.tsx, components/calendar/block-form.tsx. KEEP native <input type="date"/"time"> in manual-booking-form and block-form. Preserve the grid geometry from lib/calendar-layout, all changeBookingStatus/createManualBooking/block server actions, the idempotency nonce in manual-booking-form, STATUS_STYLE (icon + distinct border style per status, never colour alone), the role=group/aria-current controls, and the calendar i18n keys. FormSheet here is dashboard-only and safe to restyle.

For all of the above: where a file imports inputClass/primaryBtn/secondaryBtn/dangerBtn from components/calendar/fields.tsx, replace those visual class strings at the dashboard call site with shadcn Button/Input styling. You MAY keep importing the pure aria helpers Field/fieldAria (no visual identity) for accessibility, but do NOT change the exported strings in components/calendar/fields.tsx itself (admin pages depend on them).
acceptance_criteria: Services, team, hours, profile, the owner reviews controls, and every calendar component render with the shadcn look; the edited dashboard files no longer use var(--text-*)/var(--radius-*)/var(--label*)/var(--tint)/var(--control-border) arbitrary classes except where intentionally kept (native color input, brand preview).
All native inputs remain native: `grep -rn 'type="date"\|type="time"\|type="color"'` across the edited files still shows them present.
components/calendar/fields.tsx exported class strings are unchanged (admin still uses them); components/reviews/review-form.tsx and components/manage/* shared APIs are unchanged.
No server action, data loader, validation schema usage, idempotency nonce, or i18n key changed; no new message keys (or any new key added to all three locales).
STATUS_STYLE still distinguishes each booking status by icon + border style (not colour alone).
verification: pnpm test lib/services-schema.test.ts lib/team-schema.test.ts lib/days-off.test.ts lib/hours.test.ts lib/hours-schema.test.ts lib/profile-schema.test.ts lib/brand.test.ts lib/photos-schema.test.ts lib/calendar-layout.test.ts lib/calendar-params.test.ts lib/calendar-schema.test.ts lib/block-expansion.test.ts lib/booking-status.test.ts

git diff --name-only : confirm only in-scope dashboard files changed; no app/[locale]/b/**, admin/**, account/**, auth, lib/**, app/actions/**, or .kiro/steering/** files; components/calendar/fields.tsx, components/manage/confirm-sheet.tsx, components/reviews/review-form.tsx, components/error-state.tsx, components/focus-heading.tsx not modified.
findings: Restyled services (page + services-manager + service-form), team (page + team-manager + staff-form), hours (page + hours-editor + closures-manager), profile (page + profile-form + brand-form + photos-manager), the owner reviews controls (owner-reply-form + report-review-button), and the full calendar subsystem (calendar page + calendar-grid + form-sheet + booking-details + manual-booking-form + block-form) to shadcn/ui. Added the missing components/ui/textarea.tsx primitive (shadcn add needs the registry; wrote it by hand matching the installed input.tsx look). Each dashboard call site that previously pulled inputClass/primaryBtn/secondaryBtn/dangerBtn from components/calendar/fields.tsx now uses shadcn Button/Input/Textarea/Card/Separator/Badge; the pure aria helper fieldAria is still imported for accessibility wiring, and components/calendar/fields.tsx exported strings were NOT modified (admin still depends on them). Forms with the shared Field visual wrapper now use a small local Field built on shadcn Label (same aria ids: <id>-hint / <id>-err, aria-describedby, aria-invalid) so no accessibility wiring changed. Native <input type=date|time|color> stay native, styled with className only (grep confirms 17 occurrences across the six form files). STATUS_STYLE keeps a distinct icon + border STYLE per status (dashed/solid primary, solid success, double destructive, dotted border + line-through for cancelled) so status is never colour alone; the string lives in dashboard-only booking-details.tsx and is reused by calendar-grid EventButton. Calendar grid hatch/gridline inline styles switched from var(--separator)/var(--bg) to var(--border)/var(--muted) (shadcn tokens, both defined as raw CSS vars in globals.css). No server action, data loader, zod schema usage, idempotency nonce, or i18n key was touched; no new message strings were added. Verification: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit (0 errors), pnpm lint (clean; only a pre-existing unused-var warning in app/actions/auth.ts, out of scope), pnpm check:messages (en/el/ru in sync), the 13 named lib test files (154 tests) all pass, pnpm build prerenders all locales. git diff confirms only in-scope dashboard files + the new components/ui/textarea.tsx changed; no app/[locale]/b/**, admin/**, account/**, auth, lib/**, app/actions/**, .kiro/steering/** files, and components/calendar/fields.tsx, components/manage/*, components/reviews/review-form.tsx, components/error-state.tsx, components/focus-heading.tsx were not modified.
